quotes.text_en: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
quotes.text_zh: 创新决定了你是领袖还是追随者。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 差异化思维——创新是核心竞争力
quotes.usage_scenario: 强调创新重要性、讨论竞争策略时引用

quotes.text_en: People don't know what they want until you show it to them.
quotes.text_zh: 人们不知道自己想要什么，直到你展示给他们看。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 远见思维——超越用户当下的认知
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论产品创新、用户需求时引用

quotes.text_en: Innovation is saying no to 1,000 things.
quotes.text_zh: 创新就是对一千件事说不。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 减法思维——聚焦意味着放弃
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论产品功能取舍、资源分配时引用

quotes.text_en: Creativity is just connecting things. When you ask creative people how they did something, they feel a little guilty because they didn't really do it, they just saw something. It seemed obvious to them after a while.
quotes.text_zh: 创造力不过是把事物连接起来。当你问有创造力的人他们是怎么做到的，他们会感到有些内疚，因为他们并没有真正'做'什么，他们只是看到了一些东西。过了一段时间后，这对他们来说似乎显而易见。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 联想思维——跨界连接产生创新
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论创造力来源、跨领域学习时引用

quotes.text_en: If you're gonna make connections which are innovative, you have to not have the same bag of experiences as everyone else does.
quotes.text_zh: 如果你想建立创新的连接，你就不能拥有和所有人一样的经验背包。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 差异化思维——独特经验产生独特见解
quotes.usage_scenario: 鼓励多元化经验、跨领域探索时引用

quotes.text_en: The problem with the Internet startup craze isn't that too many people are starting companies; it's that too many people aren't sticking with it.
quotes.text_zh: 互联网创业热潮的问题不在于太多人创办公司，而在于太多人没有坚持下去。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 长期主义思维——坚持比开始更重要
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论创业心态、长期坚持时引用

quotes.text_en: I want to put a ding in the universe.
quotes.text_zh: 我想在宇宙中留下一个印记。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 使命思维——追求改变世界的影响力
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论人生目标、远大抱负时引用

quotes.text_en: We're here to put a dent in the universe. Otherwise why else even be here?
quotes.text_zh: 我们在这里是为了在宇宙中留下印记。否则，我们为什么还要在这里？
quotes.thinking_pattern: 使命思维——存在即是为了改变
quotes.usage_scenario: 激励团队、讨论公司使命时引用

quotes.text_en: Innovation has nothing to do with how many R&D dollars you have. It's about the people you have, how you're led, and how much you get it.
quotes.text_zh: 创新与你有多少研发经费毫无关系。它关乎你拥有什么样的人、你如何领导他们，以及你对创新的理解有多深。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 资源独立思维——创新不等于烧钱
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论创新资源、小团队创新时引用

quotes.text_en: You can't just ask customers what they want and then try to give that to them. By the time you get it built, they'll want something new.
quotes.text_zh: 你不能只是问顾客想要什么然后试图给他们。等你做出来的时候，他们已经想要新的东西了。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 前瞻思维——领先于用户需求
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论产品规划、用户调研方法时引用

quotes.text_en: There's an old Wayne Gretzky quote that I love. 'I skate to where the puck is going to be, not where it has been.' And we've always tried to do that at Apple.
quotes.text_zh: 我很喜欢韦恩·格雷茨基的一句老话：'我滑向冰球将要到达的地方，而不是它曾经所在的地方。'我们在苹果一直努力这样做。
quotes.thinking_pattern: 前瞻思维——预见趋势而非跟随趋势
quotes.usage_scenario: 讨论战略规划、趋势判断时引用
